Start here

Never played before? It takes two minutes to learn.

The box plays two games. This is Word, the one you play sitting down, and it's the one to start with. Six steps and you know it.

  1. 1
    Sit in a circle One person holds the box to start with. It gets passed around. If the screen is black, tap it and it wakes up.
  2. 2
    Pick your numbers Tap Word on the menu. It asks how many of you there are, how many imposters to hide among you, and whether the imposter gets a hint. Three screens, then tap START. Start with one imposter.
  3. 3
    Pass it around The box names whoever is next. That player takes it, taps the arrow, holds the button down to see their own card, lets go, and taps Next. Don't let anyone else see it. Keep going until everyone has looked.
  4. 4
    Now you know Most of you saw the same secret word. You're the crew. The rest saw the word IMPOSTER and a one word hint instead, and have no idea what the real word is. They're the imposters. Everyone saw the category, which is just the sort of thing the word is, like Food. The box picks that at random. Nobody chooses it.
  5. 5
    One clue each The box says who goes first. Go around the circle and each say one word about the secret word. Out loud, one word, no explaining it. The imposters have to give a clue too, and have to make theirs up.
  6. 6
    Vote, then tap Reveal Talk about who sounded suspicious, then everyone points at once on the count of three, so nobody can hang back and copy. Most votes is out. Then tap Reveal and the box tells you the word and who was lying.
One round, start to finish

Four of you're playing, with one imposter. The box says the category is Food. Three of you hold the button and see the word Pizza. The fourth sees IMPOSTER and the hint melted, and doesn't know the word. Round you go: "cheese", "delivery", "slice", and then the imposter, who has to say something, works out that melted plus Food is probably something hot and says "oven". It nearly fits. Then you talk it over, point on three, and tap Reveal to find out if you got the right person.

The only three rules for your clue

Don't say the secret word. Don't be so obvious that the imposter works it out. Do not be so vague that everyone starts looking at you.

If nothing happens when you tap, it’s locked rather than broken

There's a padlock at the top of the screen. While it's shut, nothing else on the screen answers, so the box can't get tapped by accident while it's being passed. Tap the padlock and it all works again. How the lock works →

Want the outdoor version?

Tag mode plays the same idea outside, with tagging instead of clues. How tag mode works →
